entities.summary: Muhammad al-Amin al-Kanemi, also known by the nickname Laminu, was an Islamic scholar and teacher, and a religious, military, and political leader who was instrumental in saving the Kanem–Bornu Empire during the Fula jihads in the early 19th century.
